facts.fact: According to Deloitte's estimates cited by StackAdapt, women's share of the overall global tech workforce increased 6.9% from 2019 to 2022.
facts.quote: According to Deloitte’s estimates, women’s share in the overall global-tech workforce has increased 6.9% from 2019 to 2022

facts.fact: According to Deloitte's estimates cited by StackAdapt, women's share of technical roles in the global tech industry grew by 11.7% from 2019 to 2022.
facts.quote: while their share in technical roles has grown by 11.7%

facts.fact: According to Deloitte's estimates cited by StackAdapt, the percentage of women in tech leadership roles grew by nearly 20% over the last three years.
facts.quote: The percentage of women in leadership roles has grown by nearly 20% in the last three years.
